scope: Unqualified allocator-layout repair hypothesis: move section-pool links out of Scheme payload; preserve allocation order and O(1) push/pop
pathRelevance: The exact parent image faults at the first-break initialization store after a pool pop. Its computed stack start is unaligned. The two pool pops obtain their successor from base[0], and overflow undo stores it there. This is an in-band metadata alias, not proof of the first corrupting native writer.
priorExploration: Existing invalidation, GC pool reset and publication repairs are already present. They are not reapplied. No out-of-payload section-pool link exists in the parent.
expectedBenefit: Preserve allocator-link identity under the explicitly modeled payload-write fault envelope without locks, searches, skipped work or discarded sections. No speedup percentage or complete native repair is claimed; unrelated section-head/descriptor/ownership corruption may still fail.

separate metadata survives the same alias envelope
full bootstrap and all unchanged compiled stress files remain required
abi: Darwin GNU msection layout changes by one pointer; allocation size follows sizeof_msection; a complete bootstrap must rebuild consumers. Linux layout and link storage remain unchanged.
